## 改了什么

**批注对应句**（Discussion 第一段开头，M. Keller 的批注 “Please compare this with previous studies here.” 正是锚定在这一句上）：

原文：
> The aim of our study was to assess the relationship between depression and personal hygiene practices among university students along with the validation of our newly developed personal hygiene questionnaire in order to make this self-rated questionnaire.

改为（带修订标记的插入/删除，可在 Word 中接受或拒绝）：
> Whereas previous studies at university settings have reported associations between depression and unhealthy lifestyles and disruption of daily routine activities [7, 10], and depressive symptoms have been linked with the neglect of self-care routines [5, 6], comparable evidence on personal hygiene practices among university students in Bangladesh remains scarce; the aim of our study was therefore to assess the relationship between depression and personal hygiene practices among university students, together with the validation of our newly developed, self-rated personal hygiene questionnaire.

要点：
1. 不再只是平铺直叙“研究目的”，而是先把本研究放到既往文献中作对照：大学场景下抑郁与不健康生活方式、日常作息紊乱的关联 [7, 10]；抑郁症状与自我照护缺失的关联 [5, 6]。
2. 明确指出孟加拉国大学生个人卫生实践方面的可比证据仍缺乏，从而自然过渡到研究目的与问卷验证目标，并与后一句 “In our study, we identified…” 衔接。
3. 只使用了引言中已出现过的文献编号（[5, 6]、[7, 10]），**没有引入新编号**，因此不影响参考文献顺序（Zotero 域不会重排）；也没有新增未经原文支持的具体数据。
4. 原句末尾冗余的表达 “…in order to make this self-rated questionnaire” 顺带理顺为 “self-rated personal hygiene questionnaire”。
